df_world.name: The Fictional Cabinet of Loose Claims

artifact.item_description: A granite slab, its surface crowded with careful lettering.[B]The export records an inscription; a later learning event names this slab.
In memory of a patient clerk. The lettering is neat and entirely unhelpful to immortality.
This slab contains the secrets of life and death.
A copper-bound book. Several pages are devoted to the virtues of keeping receipts.
An iron axe, named with unusual optimism.

historical_event.secret_text: a teaching whose source is uncertain
